headline_fact: On July 29, 2026, the Federal Open Market Committee voted 9-3 to hold the federal funds rate at a target range of 3.5% to 3.75%, with three regional bank presidents dissenting as inflation has stayed above the Fed's 2% goal for more than five years.
narration_script: On July 29, 2026, the Federal Open Market Committee decided to keep interest rates at a range of 3.5% to 3.75%, with three regional bank presidents disagreeing due to persistent inflation above the Fed's target.
